title: Stuffed Portobello Mushrooms
description: Meaty portobello caps filled with spinach, garlic, tomato and melting mozzarella, topped with crisp breadcrumbs and baked.

image.alt: Portobello caps filled with a golden, herby cheese stuffing

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 400F oven}. Brush the mushroom caps all over with 1 tbsp oil, sprinkle with half the salt and roast gill side up for {time 10 min}. Pour off any liquid.

Meanwhile heat 1 tbsp oil in the skillet and cook the garlic for {time 30 sec}. Add the spinach and the rest of the salt and cook until wilted, {time 2 min}. Stir in the tomatoes and mozzarella off the heat.
Toss the panko and grated cheese with the remaining oil.
Fill the mushroom caps with the spinach mixture and top with the crumbs. Bake until the cheese is melted and the crumbs golden, {time 12-15 min}. Scatter with basil.

notes: Scraping out the dark gills with a spoon keeps the filling from turning muddy.
